failure_modes: Selecting C009-C011 would blend an unvalidated observed-teacher coordinate term into the endpoint reward, displacing surrounding coordinates without evidence of final-affinity gain.
Selecting C001-C003 or C005-C007 would change dose or teacher-neighbor count, altering the shared learned support while leaving the hypothesized time-conditioned attention unimplemented.

Any time-conditioned rule keyed to landmark contrast could be mis-specified because the observed landmark trends are non-monotone with strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial, risking opposite-sign endpoint shape_yy/shape_xx response.

rationale: Analyst's signed coordinate evidence is endpoint-integrated shape_yy/shape_xx and centroid_y contrasts (E3114d60bf4cd5720, Ecbb36ef90768cba0, E52fcd92a3390dbcf), but the continuous landmark trends over the observed window are non-monotone with multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb, E598d52f84227fbcc, E1ba2a68ba5243c03). H001 and H002 both require a time-conditioned regional attention rule keyed to validated landmark contrast changes at observed score nodes, yet no validated contrast function is supplied and no final-affinity outcome is available (E0857891f4effbfe1, Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1). The registered choices only offer pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), region_index (C004), teacher_neighbors (C005-C007), temporal_region_index (C008) and temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011); none is bound to a validated landmark contrast, and the incumbent already uses pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, teacher_score_beta=0, time_ramp_power=0.0. Changing dose (C001-C003) or neighbor count (C005-C007) would not implement the hypothesized time-conditioned attention and would alter the shared learned support without evidence of affinity benefit; temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011) would mix an unvalidated observed-teacher term into the endpoint reward. Under the affinity-first priority and with no decoded terminal labels, retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice.
